    Med Fabric

    Med Fabric is an Elixir poncho for durable remote clinical encounters, atomic clinician observation acceptance, and HL7 FHIR R4 delivery. The exam uses one Welded :med_ex SDK for WebRTC preview and recording.

    Projects

    PathResponsibility
    core/domainBind acquisition facts and decide explicit acceptance in pure Elixir
    core/storeCommit acceptance, provenance, and outbox in one PostgreSQL transaction
    core/interopDeliver and confirm one reviewed observation over FHIR R4
    apps/examBoot Phoenix, authorize the lab, and host the review and delivery UI

    Follow the native browser-to-record runbook for Ubuntu 26.04 onboarding, diagrams, focused tests, and the listening check.
